activeConceptDefinition: 다항식의 근·중근·곱구조를 인수분해하여 함수·도함수·방정식의 구조를 분석하는 개념.
rule: A known cubic root must first be factored out to expose the residual quadratic. Factorization is an additional decisive concept outside the discriminant-primary L3. CC_DISCRIMINANT duplicates that L3, while CC_CUBIC_EQUATION only names the ambient equation. Removing factorization prevents the residual-quadratic discriminant test.

items.reason: Factor the fixed cubic root −2 to obtain x²+2mx+3; only after that factorization can D, axis location, and endpoint signs constrain the residual roots.
Factor the guaranteed root x=0 from the cubic, leaving 3x²−2mx+3; the quadratic discriminant then counts when two additional distinct real roots exist.
Factor the known root x=1 from the cubic to expose kx²+(2k+2)x+k+3; D>0 and the no-shared-root check apply only to that residual factor.
